details.about: Mastercard's Service Operations Technology (SOT) BizOps team keeps enterprise platforms reliable, observable and secure. This foundational-level Site Reliability Engineer role supports enterprise infrastructure, configuration management, discovery, asset and inventory, automation and operational technology platforms, while building skills at the meeting point of software engineering and production operations, with guidance from experienced engineers.
duties: Support the daily operation and maintenance of enterprise platforms and infrastructure
Monitor service health, availability, performance and capacity
Troubleshoot basic-to-moderate issues across application, infrastructure, network and OS layers, escalating complex ones
Support production incidents and take part in root cause analysis
Handle routine Linux/Unix administration, patching, upgrades, releases and deployments
Contribute scripts and tools that automate repetitive work
Improve monitoring, alerting and dashboards with tools such as Splunk and Dynatrace
Work with REST APIs, source control, CI/CD and configuration management
Keep documentation, procedures and troubleshooting guides up to date
needs: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Foundational knowledge of Linux/Unix systems and administration
Foundational programming or scripting in Python, PowerShell, Bash, Java, Go or similar
Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSH and basic troubleshooting
Familiarity with monitoring, logging, alerting and observability
Understanding of production support, incident response and change management
Systematic troubleshooting, clear documentation and strong communication
nice: Production support of enterprise applications or infrastructure
Splunk, Dynatrace or similar observability tools
Git/Bitbucket, Jenkins, XLR, Chef or Ansible
CMDB, discovery or ITSM tools such as BMC Discovery or Remedy
Linux, cloud, security, DevOps or SRE certifications
details.benefits: Base salary $61,000 – $102,000 a year in O'Fallon, Missouri; may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. Benefits generally include medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; flexible spending and health savings accounts; 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave; 80 hours of paid sick and safe time, 25 days of vacation and 5 personal days (pro-rated by hire date); 10 paid U.S. holidays; a 401k with company match; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; and tuition reimbursement eligibility.
notes: Mastercard intends to fill this position by 02/03/2027
Accommodations for the application process: reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com
